# uptriva CLI

Command-line client for the Uptriva monitoring API. Use it to manage
monitors, incidents, contacts, webhooks, groups, maintenance windows and
status pages from a terminal or script.

## Auth

- `uptriva auth login --token <token>` stores the token at
  `~/.config/uptriva/config.yaml` (0600). Interactive prompt works too.
- `UPTRIVA_TOKEN` and `UPTRIVA_API_URL` env vars override the config.
- Tokens come from the Uptriva dashboard (Security → API tokens). Scoped
  tokens (`monitors:write`, page-restricted) are enforced server-side.
- `uptriva auth whoami` prints endpoint + masked token. `logout` removes it.

## Output

- Tables by default. `-o json` returns raw API JSON — always use it when
  parsing output programmatically.
- Most commands accept a name OR an id/short-id prefix: `uptriva monitors
  pause Website` resolves "Website" to its UUID. `--status-page` accepts
  ids (and slugs on `watch`/`status-pages show`).
- Errors exit non-zero with a human message; `plan upgrade required: ...`
  indicates a tier-gated feature.

## Commands

```
monitors list [--status-page <id>] [--type <t>] [--status <s>]
monitors show <id|name>          details + recent checks
monitors create --type <t> --target <t> --status-page <id> [--name] [--interval]
monitors update <id|name> [--name] [--target] [--interval]
monitors pause|resume|delete <id|name>
heartbeat <id|name>              push a heartbeat ping (heartbeat monitors)
watch [--status-page <id|slug>]  live status TUI, 10s refresh

status-pages list|show|create|delete|update
incidents list|create|update <id> --message|ack|resolve|publish|unpublish
maintenance list|create|delete --status-page <id>
contacts list|create|delete      --status-page required (email/slack/telegram/sms/phone)
webhooks list|create|delete|test <id>
groups list|create|delete

agents                           fleet status
agents enroll-token --name <n>   issue an enrollment token
agent-events acknowledge|resolve|reopen <id>

sla get|targets --status-page <id>
overview                         uptime summary + top agents
auth login|logout|whoami
```

## Monitor types

http, tcp, dns, ping, icmp, ssl, domain, smtp, pop3, imap, telnet, udp,
ftp, sftp, ssh, dnsbl, postgres, mysql, redis, rabbitmq, kafka, mqtt,
agent, heartbeat, composite, game_server, lavalink, api, kube_deploy,
docker, podman, docker_swarm, kubernetes, proxmox, vmware, ceph,
network_device, snmp — availability depends on the account's plan tier.

## Scripted use

- `apply -f config.yaml` is planned for declarative setup; until then use
  loops over `monitors create`.
- Example heartbeat flow: create a `heartbeat` monitor → read its
  `settings.heartbeat_token` via `monitors show <name> -o json` →
  `POST /heartbeat/<id>` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (or just
  `uptriva heartbeat <name>`).
- Rate limit: keep below the account's per-minute API limit; `watch`
  polls every 10s.
